_about: Short visitor-facing captions for the Loan Tape screen, and the glossary terms its Explain panel offers (the first is shown open). The longer Business and Technical explanation is in loan-tape.md; every term's definition is in content/glossary.json.

captions.noteRateNote: WAC alone hides this shape: two clusters of coupons can average to a rate no loan has.
captions.panelsScope: Panels and chip counts cover the whole tape. The grid follows the chip and your column filters.
captions.gridPaging: server-paged, {blockSize} loans per block as you scroll
captions.gridServer: Sort and filter run in DuckDB, never in the browser
